thread:
Sana Patel: Hey team — quick ask. The ARB weekly has been drifting and attendance is spotty. Could we lock a cadence/time and trial a compact agenda + rotating council lead? I think we should try a 6-week rotation with an easy facilitator checklist.

Owen Li: I'm +1 for locking cadence. Tuesdays 10am PT usually works for infra folks here. :thumbsup:

Jia Gomez: Wed 2pm PT gives slightly better EMEA overlap for me. Can we pick one and commit for 6 weeks so people can plan?

Dena Kapoor: Agree on a compact agenda. Also +1 on making pre-reads mandatory (even just a 2-line TL;DR). Can we add a required "decision asked" line in RFCs?

Sana Patel: Yep — that's the idea. Proposal: move to biweekly Tue/Wed alternate? But simpler is weekly locked time. Here's a suggested compact agenda template:
```
Agenda template:
- 5m: Pre-read check (owners confirm links + TL;DR)
- 25m: RFC review (owner + 10m discussion + 10m Q + 5m capture)
- 15m: Design deep-dive (optional, reserved time)
- 10m: Triage / quick blockers
- 5m: Action items + owners
Notes: Pre-reads must be linked in calendar invite; include `Decision asked:` field in the body.
```

arb-coordinator: Calendar poll created: https://calendar.google.com/poll/arb-cadence — please vote by EOD Friday. I set candidate slots: Tue 10am PT, Wed 2pm PT, Thu 9am PT.

Owen Li: Voted. If we pick Tue 10am PT I can take facilitator week 1 (Apr 2) and shadow week 2 if needed.

Jia Gomez: Voted for Wed 2pm PT but can flip if majority prefers Tue. I can shadow Apr 2 and facilitate Apr 16 if needed.

Dena Kapoor: If we require pre-reads, can we add a simple checklist for owners? Something like: 1) PR/RFC link, 2) TL;DR (<=3 lines), 3) Decision asked (Yes/No + details), 4) Expected duration.

Sana Patel: Love that checklist. I'll add to the ARB repo docs. Quick facilitator checklist draft:
```
Facilitator checklist:
- Confirm pre-reads are attached in invite before EOD prior meeting
- Start meeting with 30s recap of goals
- Keep timebox (use timer)
- Capture decisions in meeting notes and assign owners
- Post summary in #architecture within 24h
```

arb-coordinator: Noted. I'll update the template in the repo and attach to the calendar invite. Also enabling a "required attachments" note so invites without links trigger a gentle reminder.

Owen Li: Small nit — can we make the design deep-dive slot optional that can be reclaimed if not used? Otherwise meetings stretch.

Sana Patel: Yes — mark it as optional/overflow. If unused, we move straight to triage.

Jia Gomez: One more ask — can we add a single line in the invite for "impact area" (e.g., runtime, infra, API) so the right engineers join?

Dena Kapoor: Good call. That will help triage.

arb-coordinator: Poll closes Fri 5pm PT. Current volunteers for facilitation: Owen (Apr 2), Jia (Apr 16), Dena (Apr 30) — please update if that changes. I'll create the 6-week recurring invite after poll.

Sana Patel: Thanks y'all. If we land on Tue 10am PT I'll send the first invite and add the new agenda + checklist to the ARB README. :rocket:

Owen Li: 👍

Jia Gomez: 👍

Dena Kapoor: :thumbsup:
